items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only site-factory execution and retain driveford.net as the strongest candidate. Launch package: site brief records scaffold lifecycle, existing site/ops capabilities, and no evidenced description, analytics, affiliate setup, traffic, revenue, or attribution; reusable template is limited to branded homepage structure, navigation, legal surfaces, consent-safe measurement hooks, and rollbackable preview assets; content seed remains draft-only pending owner review; SEO baseline and affiliate readiness remain unknown until evidenced. Compliance, legal, security, measurement, owner, validation, and rollback gates are mandatory. Keep the site preview-only: do not add domains, spend, deploy, publish, configure credentials, or launch. Exactly one next step: continue the existing driveford.net execution-owner verification and attach dated evidence of an assigned owner, then re-evaluate the launch-readiness gate.
